2609.28322.title: Learning the Cost of Reliable Inference
2609.28322.paper_summary: Benchmarking and routing platforms increasingly act as intermediaries connecting large language model providers with end-users. However, providers on these platforms typically use a fixed price per token, preventing users from achieving the most competitive price for their tasks. % workloads. In this work, we design a procurement platform where token prices for each task are driven by provider competition, enabling users to secure competitive pricing for guaranteed quality levels. To this end, the platform sequentially routes queries via a reverse second-price auction that incentivizes model providers to truthfully bid their best estimate of the average cost to serve a user's query. As it routes queries, the platform learns the quality offered by each provider and progressively routes queries to the most cost-competitive provider among those meeting a desired quality threshold. To validate our design, we conduct experiments with multiple LLMs from the \texttt{Llama} and \texttt{Qwen} families on popular mathematical reasoning and question-answering benchmarks. The results show that the pricing margin of the most cost-competitive provider on our platform varies significantly---from $10\%$ to $71\%$---depending on the task and quality threshold. This suggests a substantial inefficiency in the current fixed-price market, and it demonstrates that our platform may enable users to capture maximum savings whenever competitive market conditions permit.
2609.28322.paper_summary_zh: 基準測試和路由平台越來越多地充當中介，將大型語言模型提供者與最終用戶連接起來。<lb/>然而，這些平台上的提供者通常使用固定的每個標記價格，這使得用戶無法為他們的任務獲得最具競爭力的價格。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們設計了一個採購平台，讓每個任務的標記價格由提供者之間的競爭驅動，使得用戶能夠以保證的質量水平獲得具競爭力的定價。<lb/>為此，該平台通過反向第二價格拍賣依次路由查詢，激勵模型提供者真實地出價他們對服務用戶查詢的平均成本的最佳估計。<lb/>在路由查詢的過程中，該平台學習每個提供者所提供的質量，並逐步將查詢路由到那些滿足所需質量閾值的最具成本競爭力的提供者。<lb/>為了驗證我們的設計，我們在流行的數學推理和問答基準上，對來自\texttt{Llama}和\texttt{Qwen}系列的多個LLM進行了實驗。<lb/>結果顯示，我們平台上最具成本競爭力的提供者的定價利潤差異顯著——從$10\%$到$71\%$——這取決於任務和質量閾值。<lb/>這表明當前固定價格市場存在顯著的低效，並且顯示我們的平台可能使得用戶在競爭市場條件允許的情況下獲得最大節省。
